thread:
Maya: Heads-up - several onboarding jobs failed to finish between 07:10-07:45 UTC causing partial index writes for ~9 customers. They see missing items in search and some onboarding steps stuck.
Leo: Thanks, investigating. Logs show a transient auth token rotation race in the ingest worker pool. Suspect the new token refresh backoff we added last week.
Ibrahim: Can we hotfix the worker to retry more aggressively and re-run the failed jobs? I can patch and kick off retries in the next 15m.
Priya: Drafting comms for affected accounts. Tone should be apologetic, give clear next steps, and offer reindex assistance + optional 5% service credit. Also flag renewal-risk accounts for 1:1 outreach.
Eve (Legal): Avoid saying "data lost". Use "may have experienced partial indexing delays" and offer reindex as an option we will perform on request. Also OK to offer credit.
Maya: Agreed. Also include an in-product banner for affected tenants: short + link to CS contact.
Leo: Patch ready. Deploying to worker pool now. ETA ~12m for roll-forward validation. I will post metrics.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-442 created, severity P3, ops bridge scheduled.
Ibrahim: Retry job queue processing now started. 56 jobs in backlog; auto-retries should pick up 35 immediately. Will monitor.
Priya: Draft snippet: ```Hi — We identified an issue during onboarding earlier today that may have resulted in incomplete indexing for some items. Our engineering team has applied a fix and we can re-run indexing for you on request. If you notice missing search results or incomplete onboarding, please reply to this message or contact your CS rep and we will prioritize a manual reindex. We apologize for the disruption and will share an RCA once available. — Redwood Inference Customer Success```
Eve (Legal): Change "resulted in incomplete indexing" to "may have resulted" and add "no customer data was exfiltrated"? Wait - legal prefers avoid assertive statements about exfiltration unless confirmed. Replace with "we have no indication of data exposure".
Priya: Updated copy accordingly. Adding scheduled office hours at 11:00 UTC for affected customers and a short FAQ link.
Maya: Nice. Priya, can you also prepare a high-touch email template for the top 5 renewal-risk accounts with offer for live troubleshooting + a credit proposal?
Priya: On it. Will include personalized escalation and suggested 5% service credit + complimentary reindex.
Leo: Metrics update: backlog processing at 85% done, search result coverage trending back to baseline in most tenants. Full catch-up expected by 08:30 UTC.
Ibrahim: One caveat: two customers with very large indexes need manual reindex to fully reconcile — flagging them for CS.
Maya: Noted. Sarah (renewals) added to the list. Priya, tag those two accounts for immediate 1:1.
Priya: Done. Final comm ready in docs folder. Sending after Maya sign-off.
Maya: Sign-off given. Sending now. Also creating a follow-up survey for impacted accounts to capture feedback and update account health scores.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-442 status -> mitigated at 08:28 UTC, postmortem scheduled.
Maya: Thanks team. After RCA, we'll loop in product on token-refresh backoff logic and add a mitigation plan for onboarding spikes.
